notes.title: INFRA patch notes for January 27th
notes.content:
Hello!

Unfortunately this patch isn't fully compatible with all saved games. After downloading the update, the game might prompt you to restart the level if we've made extensive changes to that level in this update.

If you choose to restart the level, you won't lose any of your general progress (such as the number of photos taken), but you'll have to play through that level again.

If you don't want to update yet, you can right-click INFRA on Steam, select "Properties", "Betas" and "3.3.1" from the drop-down menu. This will keep the game on the previous version until you're ready to update. When you want to update to the latest version, you can use the same drop-down menu to select "NONE - opt out of all beta programs".

notes.title: INFRA patch notes for November 1st
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11558759/0fac1137821f86b2f405c681e843a4bc9e90bdb7.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

It's now been a bit over a month since the release of INFRA: Part 3. We've released a couple of smaller patches (for which you can find the change notes [url=https://github.com/loiste-interactive/infra-issues/blob/master/CHANGES.md]here[/url]), but now it's time for a larger update.

This update adds additional detail to the city levels in the third act of the game, and fixes a large amount of bugs, which unfortunately requires breaking compatibility with some of the existing saved games.

We're also releasing the VMF source files for all the levels in the game (and even some previously unseen levels) to be used by modders. These files can be downloaded from [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B9vYIPZcARSNbjJLZThRckFZdjA/view]here.[/url]

Regarding saved game compatibility, after downloading the update, the game might prompt you to restart the level, depending on if we've made changes to that level in this update. If you choose to restart the level, your general progress will be retained (such as the number of photos taken).

If you don't want to update yet, you can right-click INFRA on Steam, select "Properties", "Betas" and "3.0.9" from the drop-down menu. This will keep the game from updating until you feel like you're ready to do so. When you're ready to update, you can use the same drop-down menu to select "NONE - opt out of all beta programs", which will update the game to the latest version.

notes.title: INFRA: Part 2 patch released
notes.content:
We've just released update [b]2.3.0[/b]. While we're still hard at work on INFRA: Part 3, this patch focuses on fixing some long-standing issues and providing overall quality of life improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]Intro improvements.[/b] The intro briefing scene has received new character animations, and some character models have been improved. The intro can now be skipped from the pause menu. The whole first level has received some additional polish.
[*] [b]Options are now accessible from the pause menu.[/b] Key bindings, video settings, audio settings, everything can now be tweaked without leaving the game.
[*] [b]Lots of bugfixes and level improvements.[/b] This update contains over a hundred individual changes across both INFRA: Part 1 and INFRA: Part 2 levels. The full patch notes can be found [url=https://github.com/loiste-interactive/infra-issues/blob/master/CHANGES.md]here.[/url]
[/list]

[b]Unfortunately this update is not fully compatible with existing saved games.[/b]

If you try to load an old saved game, the game might prompt you to restart the level. If you decide to restart the level, you will [i]only[/i] lose progress [i]within that level[/i]. The game will remember all your photos, repaired spots and other choices when you restart the level.

[b]If you don't want to update yet[/b], that's [i]fine[/i]. We've created a Steam beta branch that will keep the game version at 2.2.0 (that's the version prior to this patch).

If you choose not to update, right-click INFRA on Steam, select "Properties", "Betas" and "2.2.0" from the drop-down menu. When you feel like you're ready to update, simply opt out of this branch. We recommend doing so at the start of a level so you don't lose progress.

notes.title: Gameplay refinement update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another BIG update is here. The last big update focused on level design changes so this time the focus is shifted to perfecting gameplay mechanics. In short, all the issues regarding player movement have been fixed. Most notably the climbing mechanics have been rewritten resulting in much more predictable and stable movement. The movable crates used on many occasions now stay still too unless picked up and moved around by the player, so no more falling to the water because of wiggly crates. Some rare crash issues have also been fixed along with graphical issues when low graphical quality settings were selected.

We've also enabled [b]full Steam Cloud support.[/b]

Below is a list of universal changes. Most of the levels have had their share of fixes and changes too. Level related changes are cut out because of length restrictions. [url=https://github.com/loiste-interactive/infra-issues/blob/master/CHANGES.md]See the complete changelist here.[/url]

Also, the [b]player character's voice has been updated[/b], it is now smoother sounding and easier to understand.

notes.title: Small improvements and bugfixes
notes.content:
Hey guys,

To avoid breaking saved games this time, we put together a small patch that doesn't touch any of the maps. We're currently working on a larger patch where we can update all the maps at once.

Anyway, here are the patch notes. To mention a few highlights: the flickering particle effects are finally fixed, and the quick save and quick load keys can now be rebound in the options menu. Water splashes for physics props look a lot better now too.

[h1]Version 1.0.11[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a hint explaining the camera focus rectangle
[*]Added a hint explaining the camera successful picture sound
[*]Added a different death sound for dying in water
[*]Added a different death sound for dying in electrified water
[*]Added dynamic lighting of the water impact particle effects
[*]Added quick save and quick load to the controls in the options menu
[*]Changed the break sound of a certain glass bottle model
[*]Changed the impact sound of the brick model
[*]Changed the default binding for quick load from F7 to F9
[*]Changed the default binding for crouch to also include right control
[*]Changed the default binding for sprint to also include right shift
[*]Changed the hint display to not display the control and shift keys twice if also bound to right control and right shift
[*]Changed the amount of characters that the developer console can hold from 65536 to 131072
[*]Fixed multiline captions for hints
[*]Fixed electrical glow particles clipping through nearby geometry
[*]Fixed the down arrow and right arrow icons being the wrong way around in the options menu
[*]Fixed the options menu not binding the right shift and right control keys along with the left shift and left control keys
[*]Fixed a certain glass bottle model not floating on water
[*]Fixed water impact effects almost never occurring with physics props
[*]Fixed a missing texture on the spark particle effect when the player dies of electrocution
[*]Fixed flickering water splash particles (issue #240)
[*]Fixed the female arms crossed animation partially (issue #377)
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes, further improved controller support
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just pushed out a large patch that fixes a ton of issues. The changelog was actually so big that we had a hard time fitting it in this post. You can find the changes listed below.

[b]This update may corrupt and break save files. If you experience any issues with old saves, please restart the game at the start of that chapter. You can do that by clicking "New Game" on the main menu, and picking the latest chapter you were on.[/b]

[h1]Version 1.0.8[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added "controller sensitivity" slider to the options menu
[*]Added "invert controller look" option to the options menu (issue #331)
[*]Added album art for the soundtrack
[*]Added a hint for equipping the flashlight when first entering a really dark area
[*]Added sounds for crouching
[*]Added reslists and map sound manifests
[*]Changed the power consumption of taking a picture with the camera from 5% to 4% per picture
[*]Changed the power consumption of the camera screen from 0.5% per second to 0.33% per second (issue #323)
[*]Changed the sprint button on Xbox 360 controllers to be a toggle
[*]Changed the crouch button on Xbox 360 controllers from B to the right stick
[*]Changed the default sensitivity of Xbox 360 controllers from 2.0 to 0.6
[*]Changed the in-game computers to be usable with a Xbox 360 controller (issue #317)
[*]Changed timings on the geocache monologues so that the box open sound can be heard more clearly
[*]Changed the spacebar hint icon to be a bit smaller
[*]Changed the key icons in the options menu to use their own, smaller texture
[*]Fixed main menu skipping the chapter selection and going straight to the game if you have unlocked chapters but no saved games
[*]Fixed main menu accepting input while transitioning between screenspress would register on both screens
[*]Fixed the pause menu still accepting keyboard input after returning to the main menu
[*]Fixed the credits remaining rolling after restarting from checkpoint during the credits (issue #369)
[*]Fixed compression artifacts on some of the hint icons
[*]Fixed being able to save the game while the credits are rolling (issue #371)
[*]Fixed the hint display fonts breaking after a resolution change (issue #374)
[*]Fixed hints for the shift key not using the shift key icon
[*]Fixed black edges appearing on some hint icons with lower resolutions
[*]Fixed main menu music stopping playing after switching speaker type in the options menu (issue #375)
[*]Fixed level transitions erroneously clearing previous map state (issue #376)
[*]Fixed a rare crash when playing for an extended period of time
[/list]

[list]
[*]Changed the generic office workers to look at the player when talking to him
[*]Fixed position of the eyes for the female office worker model

[/list]

[*]Fixed the range of a certain camera target (issue #333)

[*]Changed the texture for Erik's note about Hartman
[*]Changed the texture for Lukas' note about the keypad door
[*]Fixed the range of a certain camera target (issue #332)
[*]Fixed the elevator button having two separate spots where it could be used and the other one doing nothing (issue #316)
[/list]

[b]tunnel2[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the texture for Erik's note about Robin
[*]Changed the texture for the note addressed to Marko

[*]Changed the entrance to the third fuse room
[*]Fixed missing use highlights on the blue screen computer (issue #256)
[*]Fixed the player being able to run through certain steam without dying (issue #379)

[/list]

[b]tower[/b]

Downside of this update is that savegames may have been broken from the affected level forcing players to restart the level or even the whole chapter.

We will now start working on the other bugs and issues, including some kind of a tutorial and guidance mechanics for the first level, options etc.

[*]Fixed black screen on some systems when transitioning from furnace to tower
[*]Fixed crash when transitioning from watertreatment to sewer
[*]Fixed certain documents in tunnel4 not being photographable
[*]Fixed certain subtitles not displaying in tunnel4
[/list]
